name: Horropedia
bio: Archetype: Dispel, ST DPT. ⌽ Strong ST attacks when the enemy does not have buffs. ⌽ Skill 1 can ST dispel. ⌽ Higher-tier Skills are more effective. ⌽ Ult does decent AoE damage and increases Mental DMG Taken on enemies. ⌽ Works best on stages without buffed enemies. ⌽ Synergy: [Rank Up] teammates (Mercuria, Vila, etc.)
